title: Attain three dyadic cubic repairs at every power-of-two arity
body:
The dyadic three-query question in PR6212/6215 now has a uniform solution for every r=2^s>=4: three weighted cubes on entry-source slopes r,r/2,0, realized chronologically with two integer shears. Every original cubic child remains in order; arbitrary dirty sources and the eager output are restored exactly. The existing unrestricted lower bound makes three queries optimal in this fixed interface.

The first new power-of-two count case relative to those sources is r16, with weights35/16,85/8,-205/16. None of the queried forms is pure original B, so the construction does not contradict PR6215's four-query floor when that read is required. Known r4, odd exponents and exponents divisible by six retain predecessor credit; no literature-priority claim is made.

Evidence: written all-arity coefficient/divisibility/restoration proof; four symbolic coefficient identities, three power-sum recurrences,10 coefficient fixtures through2^128, five symbolic retained-child executions,375 dirty rational cases/98,625 logical events and8 pinned-reason rejection controls. Registered normal/-O replay agrees exactly. All10 committed package/input bytes and declared source history pass. Separate AI code/proof review found no blocker; no human/kernel or hosted-CI acceptance is claimed.

Only research/cubic-pow2-repair is added, based on refreshed canonical main2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc. Source6212 head9c159482e0495b6a97e17e629debe66a0ceb9466 and6215 head0013c2b40c522ccd19670a8fbd4b1531f13fed2b remain unchanged/merged. Revision8 and selected6030 are unchanged. [Canonical claim/finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19285638). Exact source pins, bounded overlap, reproduction and remaining questions are in README/TASK/SOURCES/VALIDATION.

The five added events retain their complete coefficient-specific tariff symbols. Coefficient preparation, native/rounded implementation, routing, precision, storage/controller costs and a favorable complete backend invoice remain open. No runtime, supplier, general all-arity classification or kappa improvement is claimed.

Credit apoursh/PR6212/6215, Nick Petalas/PR6200, Sricharan Vagvala/theon199/PR1532, Adam Gall/PR1205 and Hanson Sun/PR1246. Prepared by AAAmirinu with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cubic-pow2-repair` and `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/cubic-pow2-repair --check-source-history`.
